intent.statement: Resolve Gitea issue #39 by restoring operator UI languages to en and ro, separating the eight-language Cleanup source-content contract, and restoring the settings validation test gate

spec_items.statement: The Settings interface language selector exposes exactly en and ro from config.SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.
Cleanup source-content language configuration contains exactly en, ro, de, fr, ru, pt, es and it under a Cleanup-specific constant.

examples: A settings payload containing language='fr' loads and saves as language='en'.
spec_items.statement: Settings validation replaces an interface language outside config.SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES with config.DEFAULT_LANGUAGE before use or persistence.

examples: CJK and Hangul Cleanup rejection and config.TRANSLATION_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS retain their existing behavior.
spec_items.statement: Cleanup script eligibility and AI translation target-language options remain independent of the operator interface language allowlist.

examples: With high_contrast and normal selected, Romanian displays localized theme and size labels while currentData remains high_contrast and normal.
spec_items.statement: Applying English or Romanian to Settings localizes every app-owned static label, preview string, font-size choice, and built-in theme name while preserving each combo item's stable data and current selection.

examples: Romanian Text Chunking shows localized strategy labels and guidance while the selected strategy token remains paragraph, meaning, or scene.
spec_items.statement: Applying English or Romanian to every persistent page localizes audited app-owned labels, empty states, language names, strategy choices, special values, placeholders, and tooltips without replacing project or operator content.

examples: The Cleanup prerequisite warning and Extraction progress title/status are Romanian when Romanian is active.
spec_items.statement: App-owned popup and operation-progress titles, messages, prompt labels, file filters, operation names, and initial statuses are resolved through the shared translation catalog before display.

examples: Applying Romanian while Text Cleanup is the current page rebuilds its notes in Romanian without requiring navigation away and back.
spec_items.statement: Applying a changed UI language refreshes the currently visible project page from canonical state so dynamic notes and rows immediately use the new language.
